name: Micro USB Charging Cable
subtitle: 120cm USB-A to Micro USB cable
tagline: Charge and sync Micro USB devices
description: MI Micro USB Cable connects USB-A chargers and ports to compatible Micro USB smartphones, tablets, and accessories. Its 120cm length provides flexible everyday reach, while support for up to 3A charging current and 480Mbps data transfer covers charging and basic file synchronization.
story: Designed for devices that still use a Micro USB port, this cable offers a practical connection for charging and data transfer from a USB-A source. The 120cm length gives more placement flexibility than a short cable, making it suitable for desks, bedside charging, and everyday use. Its PVC construction is listed for the cable jacket, while compatibility covers smartphones, tablets, and accessories with Micro USB input. Charging support reaches up to 3A, and data transfer is rated up to 480Mbps.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
